input: # Structured-diagnostic parity fixture: each row's input is parsed with the
# strict-JSON grammar (ts/test/json-plugin.ts / go/jsonplugin_test.go) and
# must fail; the diagnostic column is the JSON SUBSET of the serialized
# error (TS JSON.stringify(err), Go json.Marshal(err)) that both runtimes
# must emit byte-identically. message/hint/src/plugins/version are
# deliberately not asserted (non-contractual text / harness-dependent).
# len counts Unicode code points; expected is deduplicated and sorted.
# Runners: ts/test/diagnostic.test.js, go/diagnostic_spec_test.go.
abc	{code":"unterminated_string","row":1,"col":1,"pos":0,"len":4,"rule":"val","ruleStack":["val"],"expected":["#NR","#OB","#OS","#ST","#TX","#VL"],"token":{"name":"#BD","src":"\"abc"}}
# Astral character INSIDE the failing token: len counts code points (4 for
# the quoted key "b😀"), so both runtimes agree; pos/col count units before
# the token, which are all BMP here, so they agree too.
# Error on line 2: row/pos advance across the newline (input col is
# escaped: the loader turns \n into a real newline).
# Trailing content AFTER the root value completed: the root has popped, so
# ctx.rsI has gone past zero — the stack is just the failing (root) rule,
# never resurrected popped frames (TS slice(0, rsI) with a negative rsI
# used to report ["val","map","val"] / ["val","list","val"] here).
# Unclaimed character (no matcher can produce it under strict JSON): the
# error token is #BD in both runtimes, spanning the full character.
x
